provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft; host source and execution checks

draft_notes.explanation: Generator rule: blue (palette[1]) marker pairs sit on opposite borders (row r at both left/right edges, or column c at both top/bottom edges). Each pair becomes a full-span line in the output. Every red (palette[2]) rectangle whose extent satisfies line in [start-1, end] (i.e. the line crosses it or runs immediately adjacent to it) is recoloured entirely blue; others stay red. The emitted program detects both row-lines and column-lines directly in visible coordinates (the rule is symmetric under the D4 group, since both orientations are always handled and adjacency is 4-neighbour), finds red 4-connected components, recolours any component that contains or is 4-adjacent to a line cell, then draws the lines. Colour roles are palette constants. The fixtures are consistent with the generator's crossing-or-adjacent rule (the test's box at rows 0-3, cols 9-11 directly above row 4 turns blue).
draft_notes.limitations: Assumes boxes are separated (generator's overlaps check with margin 1), so each red component equals one generator box; if two boxes touched, they would be merged and activated together. Assumes the only line-coloured input cells are the border markers, as in the generator. Demonstrations are not used since the rule is fully specified.
